question: Which one of the following dance form is performed by Kuruba men in Karnataka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dollu Kunitha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dollu Kunitha** is a traditional drum dance performed by the **Kuruba community** in Karnataka.
 
• It involves energetic drumbeats and vigorous dance movements.
 
• The dance is typically performed during festivals and religious occasions.
 
• Costumes include traditional attire with decorative headgear and ankle bells.
 
• The dance is a form of **storytelling**, often depicting tales from **Hindu mythology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhau** is a semi-classical Indian dance with martial, tribal, and folk origins, primarily performed in Odisha, West Bengal, and Jharkhand.
 
• **Fugdi** is a traditional folk dance performed by the women of the **Konkan region**, which includes parts of Goa and Maharashtra.
 
• **Bagurumba** is a traditional dance of the **Bodo community** in Assam, known for its graceful movements and colorful costumes.
